svg.title: Why Girdle: measured speed, progress checks and shell checks
svg.desc: In the recorded warm Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor comparisons of 26–27 September 2026, fast flow took roughly half the mean completion time of default flow with the same observed pass rate: 19.4 versus 38.8 seconds on small fixtures, and 33.2 versus 66.2 seconds on real repositories. Repository context and batched tools reduce model round trips. Jev can nudge unfinished work and redirect loops or drift. The shell tripwire blocks recognized catastrophic cases from parsed commands and judges other risks and authorization. Checkpoints are probabilistic; ordinary sessions use the account's permissions and are not an OS sandbox.

g.aria-label: Reads and edits run in batches.
Jev can nudge the next turn
